description: Migrate the Next.js frontend to deploy on Cloudflare Pages, replacing the tRPC client with a standard REST API client that talks to the new Hono.js API on Cloudflare Workers. Update all React components and pages to use the new API client instead of tRPC hooks. Configure Cloudflare Pages with proper build settings.
steps: Create apps/web/ directory for the Cloudflare Pages frontend application (new Next.js app configured for Cloudflare Pages via @cloudflare/next-on-pages or static export)

Initialize apps/web/package.json with dependencies from root package.json frontend deps: react, react-dom, next, @clerk/nextjs, @stripe/react-stripe-js, @radix-ui/react-*, @tiptap/*, @tanstack/react-query, @tanstack/react-table, zustand, zod, tailwindcss, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, date-fns, decimal.js, lodash-es, nuqs, lucide-react, cmdk, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, use-debounce, superjson
Add devDependencies: @cloudflare/next-on-pages, wrangler, typescript, @types/react, @types/react-dom, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, @tailwindcss/typography, eslint
Create wrangler.toml for Pages: name='flexile-web', pages_build_output_dir='.vercel/output/static' (or .next for next-on-pages)

Create src/lib/api-client.ts - typed REST API client using fetch with proper error handling, auth token injection (Clerk session token), and superjson deserialization. Define typed request/response interfaces matching all Hono API endpoints

Create src/hooks/useApi.ts - React Query hooks wrapping the API client for all endpoints (replacing @trpc/react-query). Each hook maps to a specific API endpoint with proper query keys, cache invalidation, and optimistic updates
Copy all apps/next/components/ to apps/web/components/ - these are pure UI components that need no API changes (Button, Modal, Table, Select, Input, etc.)

Copy apps/next/app/ pages to apps/web/app/ - then update each page file to use new API hooks instead of trpc.*, replace trpc.useQuery with useQuery+apiClient, replace trpc.useMutation with useMutation+apiClient
Update apps/web/app/(auth)/ - login and signup pages, maintain Clerk integration
Update apps/web/app/(marketing)/ - marketing landing page (no API changes needed)
Update apps/web/app/invoices/ - all invoice pages (list, detail, edit, new) to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/equity/ - all equity pages (grants, shares, cap_table, dividends, dividend_rounds, financing_rounds, option_pools, convertibles, tender_offers) to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/people/ - people management pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/companies/ - company pages (administrator, worker, investor onboarding, expenses, investor_entities) to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/documents/ and document_templates/ - document pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/roles/ and role_applications/ - role pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/updates/ - team and company update pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/settings/ - settings pages (general, equity, payouts, tax) to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/onboarding/ - onboarding flow pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/cap_table_uploads/ - cap table upload page to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/company_invitations/ - invitation pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/talent_pool/ - talent pool pages to use REST API client
Update apps/web/app/administrator/settings/ - admin settings pages to use REST API client
Create apps/web/middleware.ts - Clerk middleware adapted for Cloudflare Pages (use @clerk/nextjs compatible with edge runtime)
Create apps/web/next.config.ts - configure for Cloudflare Pages deployment (edge runtime, no Node.js APIs in client)
Update file upload components to use R2 presigned URLs from the new API instead of S3
Remove the [...rails] catch-all proxy route - no longer needed as all API calls go to Hono Workers directly
Add scripts to apps/web/package.json: dev, build, deploy (wrangler pages deploy)
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/ directory contains a complete frontend application
All 50+ page.tsx files are migrated to use REST API client instead of tRPC
All shared UI components are preserved without modification
Clerk authentication works with Cloudflare Pages
File uploads use R2 presigned URLs
No references to tRPC remain in frontend code
verification: Run 'cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit' to verify TypeScript compilation
Run 'cd apps/web && npx next build' to verify the build succeeds
Grep for 'trpc' in apps/web/ and confirm no references remain
findings: Created apps/web/ with 232 files (66 page.tsx files, 34+ components, typed API client, React Query hooks). All tRPC references replaced with a compatibility layer (trpc/client.tsx) that routes through the REST API client using React Query hooks. The compatibility layer uses a proxy-based useUtils() for cache invalidation and typed createQueryHook/createMutationHook factories. No @trpc library packages referenced, no [...rails] proxy route, no S3/AWS SDK references. File uploads use R2 presigned URLs via /api/files/direct-upload-url. TypeScript compilation verified - only errors are from missing node_modules (npm registry blocked in sandbox as documented in FEAT-001 findings). OG image generation files were simplified to not require direct DB access (compatible with Cloudflare Pages edge runtime). The models/constants.ts was updated to import countries.json from a local data/ directory instead of the Rails config.
